title.ja: 分野ごとの実装・検証範囲

policy.ja: 項目数の拡大より、既存モデルの解説・専用コード・固定入力・参照比較・収束確認を揃えることを優先します。分野の代表例と未実装の範囲を示し、完成率や一律の認証は付けません。
policy.en: Prioritize complete paths through reading, dedicated code, fixed inputs, reference comparisons and refinement for existing models over adding entries. Show representative evidence and remaining gaps, without completion percentages or blanket certification.

scope.ja: Euler衝撃波・滑らかな渦などに複数の教育用コードと保存結果があります。固定入力での検証内容は問題ごとに異なります。 追加の固定例はWENOのε、浅水の地形・乾燥床、Re100壁面流と製造解を扱います。 円のレベルセット移流は指定した速度による界面輸送の別検証です。 0.4+sin(2πx)をT=.25まで移流。Gauss点・Radau補正のFRと既存のmodal DGをp=1/2、8/16/32セルで実行し、誤差・質量・時間積分誤差を測ります。 今回の固定例：KHの初期成長：滑らかな周期せん断層, RTの初期成長：滑らかなBoussinesq二層, 非一様移動格子で実際に運ぶALEスカラー, 2D C-grid回転浅水波の実時間発展, SRHDの対称二衝撃波衝突.
scope.en: Several educational codes and saved results cover Euler shocks and smooth vortices. Fixed-input validation differs by problem. Additional fixed cases cover WENO epsilon, shallow-water bed/dry states, and Re100 wall flow with manufactured verification. Level-set circle transport is separate interface evidence in a prescribed velocity. Transport0.4+sin(2pi x) toT=.25. Execute Gauss-node/Radau FR and the existing modal DG for p=1/2 and8/16/32 cells; measure analytic error, mass and time-integration error. Additional fixed examples: KH initial growth in a smooth periodic shear layer, RT initial growth in smooth Boussinesq double layers, ALE scalar transport on genuinely nonuniform moving cells, Actual2D C-grid rotating shallow-water time advance, SRHD symmetric two-shock collision.

reference.ja: Sodは厳密Riemann解。Shu–Osherは独立実装Athena++の保存参照と比較。細格子差と独立参照差を区別。 解析セル平均、表現した地形上の静止湖、半解析Bernoulli根、Ritter解、Ghiaの有限格子数値表と製造解を、それぞれ異なる参照として扱います。
reference.en: Sod uses the exact Riemann solution. Shu–Osher compares with a stored independent Athena++ reference. Separate fine-grid differences from independent-reference differences. Distinguish analytic cell means, lakes over the represented bed, semi-analytic Bernoulli roots, Ritter fields, finite-grid Ghia tables and manufactured references.

refinement.ja: 各実行例の格子誤差・保存則・減衰などを確認。全流体問題の一括認証ではありません。 壁面圧力は独立した演算子製造問題で、キャビティの圧力を検証したとは表示しません。
refinement.en: Checks include grid errors, conservation and decay in individual examples; this is not blanket fluid-solver certification. Wall-pressure verification is a separate operator manufactured problem, not validation of cavity pressure.

next.ja: 同じ問題で手法間の誤差・散逸・失敗条件を比較する。
next.en: Compare error, dissipation and failure conditions across methods on the same problem.

scope.ja: 旧Brio–Wu・Orszag–Tangと独立Athena++照合を保持し、移流する磁気流体静力学的平衡の構成厳密解と、同じOT初期場を使うCT／GLM比較を追加します。連続初期条件・最終時刻・実際の時間刻みを揃えた限定比較です。 物理2例の精度と、非ゼロ発散を与える制約対照での能動的なGLM輸送・減衰を分けます。 今回の固定例：円偏波Alfvén波：全成分の格子収束, 磁場ループ：独立2次元参照と細分化, 後期Orszag–Tang：独立参照と圧縮構造, SRMHDの有限振幅円偏極Alfvén波.
scope.en: Preserve the earlier Brio–Wu/Orszag–Tang independent Athena++ comparisons and add CT/GLM comparisons of a constructed exact advected magnetostatic equilibrium and the same OT data. The scoped comparisons match continuous initial conditions, final time and actual time steps. Separate accuracy in the two physical cases from active GLM transport/damping in an initially nonzero-divergence constraint control. Additional fixed examples: Circular Alfven wave: full-state refinement, Magnetic loop: independent 2D reference and refinement, Late Orszag-Tang: independent reference and compression structure, SRMHD finite-amplitude circularly polarized Alfvén wave.

reference.ja: 移流する磁気流体静力学的平衡には構成厳密解、OTには別に実行したAthena++の保存参照を使います。同じ離散系の細かい時間積分を連続PDEの独立厳密解とは呼ばず、CT固有と共通の発散診断を区別します。 制約対照はFourier解・独立した離散更新と減衰なしの伴走計算に照合し、物理問題数へ加算しません。
reference.en: Use a constructed exact solution for advected magnetostatic equilibrium and separately executed stored Athena++ references for OT. A finer time integration of the same discrete system is not an independent exact continuous-PDE reference; distinguish native CT and common divergence diagnostics. The constraint control compares Fourier solutions, an independently formed discrete update and an undamped companion; it adds no physical problem.

refinement.ja: 格子・時間刻み・独立参照自身の差を別々に測り、保存量・正値性とCT／GLM差を確認します。旧GLMの格子依存減衰と新配布版の条件を区別し、全MHD変種の保証や同一精度・同一費用の順位を付けません。
refinement.en: Measure grid, time-step and independent-reference differences separately, together with conservation, positivity and CT/GLM differences. Distinguish the earlier grid-dependent GLM damping from the new release conditions; do not claim all MHD variants or an equal-accuracy/cost ranking.

next.ja: 長時間の衝撃波・乱流、強磁場ループ、3次元・一般境界、別のCT／GLM変種は個別に検証する。
next.en: Validate long-time shocks/turbulence, strong-field loops, three dimensions, general boundaries and other CT/GLM variants separately.

scope.ja: Poisson・Bratu・粒子重力に固定入力例があります。 単位正方形の正弦製造解をGLLスペクトル要素法と既存P1三角形FEMで解きます。自由未知数を揃えたh細分化と、固定要素数でのp=1〜6を分けて測ります。 今回の固定例：L字領域P1特異解：graded格子と歪みの分離, 環状領域の可変粘性・真2DベクトルMMS, 純Neumannの互換条件と平均値ゲージ, 2D混合Robinの製造解と境界流束. 係数ジャンプの共有流束FVと、完全テンソル回転拡散Q1をMG・SA-AMGで比較する固定例もあります。
scope.en: Poisson, Bratu and particle-gravity fixed-input examples. Solve a sine manufactured solution on the unit square with GLL spectral elements and the existing triangle P1 FEM. Compare matched free-unknown counts under h refinement and p=1..6 at fixed elements. Additional fixed examples: L-corner P1 FEM: grading and separate mesh distortion, Annular variable-viscosity vector PDE MMS, Pure Neumann compatibility and mean gauge, 2D mixed Robin MMS and boundary flux. Fixed coefficient-jump shared-flux FV and full-tensor rotated-diffusion Q1 also compare geometric MG and SA-AMG.

reference.ja: 製造解、直接和、離散残差など、問題ごとの参照。参照の種類は実行ページに明記。
reference.en: Problem-specific manufactured solutions, direct sums and discrete residuals, identified in each entry.

refinement.ja: 格子・近似パラメータの収束と残差を個別に確認。
refinement.en: Individual checks of grid/approximation refinement and residuals.

next.ja: 境界条件と離散化をそろえ、残差と解誤差を比較する。
next.en: Match boundary conditions and discretizations when comparing residual and solution errors.

scope.ja: 水素型原子と球対称1 s² Heの閉殻HF・交換のみLDAに限定した2問題群です。
scope.en: Two problem families: hydrogenic atoms and spherical 1 s² helium with closed-shell HF / exchange-only LDA.

reference.ja: Hは解析解、Heは別実装PySCF/Libxc参照。有限基底・格子値・外挿推定は区別。
reference.en: Analytic hydrogen states and separate PySCF/Libxc helium references; finite-basis, grid and extrapolated values remain distinct.

refinement.ja: 半径格子の収束・SCF残差・終了条件を保存。相関エネルギーの厳密値を再現する計算ではありません。
refinement.en: Stored radial-grid convergence, SCF residuals and termination; not an exact correlated-energy calculation.

next.ja: 既存の小規模例・保存済み独立参照と配布物の整合を維持し、必要時に少数の代表再実行を行う。大規模な基底・k点走査、重い独立参照の再生成、長時間BOMD／CPMD、一般物質への拡張は、必要性が指定された場合だけ別途検討する。
next.en: Maintain the existing small examples, saved independent references and release integrity, with a few representative reruns when needed. Large basis/k-point sweeps, expensive reference regeneration, long BOMD/CPMD and general-material extensions are considered separately only on explicit need.

name.en: Quantum: H₂ HF and molecular DFT

scope.ja: 新しいH₂の閉殻RHF例：自作s型Gaussian積分、独立PySCF比較、SCF残差・基底拡大を確認。有限のs型部分空間に限定し、一般分子・分子DFT・周期系・正しい解離極限は検証しません。 別欄の固定He周期LDAは限定した例外として実行可能。
scope.en: New H₂ closed-shell RHF example: original s-Gaussian integrals, independent PySCF comparisons, SCF residuals and basis refinement. Limited to finite s-type subspaces; does not validate general molecules, molecular DFT, periodic systems or correct dissociation. The separate fixed-He periodic-LDA field supplies one scoped runnable exception.

reference.ja: H₂の同一有限基底・同一核間距離で独立PySCFと比較。自作コードの積分はPySCFから取得しない。
reference.en: Independent PySCF at identical finite bases and separations. Educational integrals are not obtained from PySCF.

refinement.ja: SCFの密度・エネルギー・交換子残差と、入れ子s型基底の隣接エネルギー差を別に評価。最終差と指定公差の成否を示す。角運動量・完全基底極限は未確認。
refinement.en: Separate SCF density/energy/commutator checks from adjacent nested-s-basis energy changes. Report the final change and tolerance outcome. Angular/complete-basis convergence is not established.

next.ja: 既存の小規模例・保存済み独立参照と配布物の整合を維持し、必要時に少数の代表再実行を行う。大規模な基底・k点走査、重い独立参照の再生成、長時間BOMD／CPMD、一般物質への拡張は、必要性が指定された場合だけ別途検討する。
next.en: Maintain the existing small examples, saved independent references and release integrity, with a few representative reruns when needed. Large basis/k-point sweeps, expensive reference regeneration, long BOMD/CPMD and general-material extensions are considered separately only on explicit need.

scope.ja: 22モデル族の文献解説に、ロジスティック増殖・閉鎖SIR、線形反応拡散、Schnakenbergの線形発現・有限振幅の非線形発展・成長後の1次元パターン、空間なしFitzHugh–Nagumoの限定例を接続します。全22族やHodgkin–Huxleyの実装ではありません。
scope.en: The 22-family survey links scoped examples of logistic growth, closed SIR, linear reaction–diffusion, linear Schnakenberg onset, finite-amplitude nonlinear evolution and post-growth 1D patterns, plus spatially uniform FitzHugh–Nagumo. This does not implement all 22 families or Hodgkin–Huxley.

reference.ja: ロジスティック・線形反応拡散は解析解、SIR/FHNは別実装DOP853、線形Turingは行列指数です。新しい非線形Schnakenbergは、脱エイリアスしたFourier–Galerkin＋Radauの独立参照と、時間誤差用の同じ差分半離散系のRadau参照を区別します。
reference.en: Analytic references for logistic/linear reaction–diffusion, independent DOP853 for SIR/FHN and matrix exponentials for linear Turing growth. New nonlinear Schnakenberg checks distinguish an independent dealiased Fourier–Galerkin/Radau reference from Radau on the same finite-difference semidiscretization used to isolate time error.

refinement.ja: 旧例の空間2次・RK4時間4次を保持。新例は中心差分の拡散を厳密に進め、反応を陰的中点則で解くStrang分割です。有限振幅の解について空間・時間を別々に細分化し、成長後のパターンでも独立参照の解像度・公差の感度を区別します。 追加の短時間例では同じ32格子・部分ソルバーでLie–TrotterとStrangの時間収束を比較し、Radau公差とDOP853の参照差を別に測ります。
refinement.en: Preserve second-order space/fourth-order RK4 time checks in the old examples. New cases combine exact finite-difference diffusion with implicit-midpoint reactions in a Strang split. Refine space and time separately for finite-amplitude solutions, distinguishing independent-reference resolution/tolerance sensitivity for post-growth patterns. An additional short-time example compares Lie–Trotter/Strang time refinement at the same 32-point grid with matched subsolvers, separately measuring Radau-tolerance and DOP853 reference differences.

next.ja: 固定した1次元周期・反射対称初期値の検証です。一般初期値からの模様選択、2次元・非周期境界、他の反応則、SEIR・完全HH、実験データへの較正と移流・流体連成は未検証です。
next.en: Validation is limited to fixed reflection-symmetric initial data in 1D periodic domains. Pattern selection from general starts, 2D/nonperiodic problems, other kinetics, SEIR/full HH, experimental calibration and advection/fluid coupling remain unvalidated.

schnakenberg_scope.ja: a=0.1,b=0.9、拡散係数0.01/1、長さ2πの1次元周期Schnakenberg系。旧線形発現例を保持し、固定した反射対称の有限振幅初期値の非線形発展と成長後パターンを独立Fourier–Galerkin/Radau参照および空間・時間細分化で比較します。一般の模様選択、2次元、生物実験への較正、流体連成には広げません。
schnakenberg_scope.en: A 1D periodic Schnakenberg system of length 2pi, a=0.1, b=0.9 and diffusivities 0.01/1. Preserve the earlier linear-onset example and compare finite-amplitude nonlinear evolution and post-growth patterns from fixed reflection-symmetric data with independent Fourier–Galerkin/Radau references and separate spatial/temporal refinement. No general pattern selection, 2D, biological calibration or fluid-coupling claim.

scope.ja: 既存のIID x²積分・スカラーItô GBM・単峰Gaussian MCMCを保持し、等重み2峰Gaussian混合の混合不良・同じ峰に留まる診断の盲点・対称反射提案を固定例で比較します。新しいrank/bulk/tail診断の照合は別の対照例です。確率計算全般の完成を意味しません。
scope.en: Preserve existing IID x² integration, scalar Itô GBM and unimodal Gaussian MCMC. Fixed examples compare poor mixing, the same-mode diagnostic blind spot and symmetry-reflection proposals for an equal-weight bimodal Gaussian mixture. New rank/bulk/tail diagnostic comparisons are separate controls, not completion of stochastic computation.

reference.ja: 旧例の解析積分・GBM解・Gaussianモーメント/CDF・既知AR(1)を保持。新標的は混合正規の既知モーメント・CDF・峰占有率と照合し、同じ鎖のACFは直接和、rank正規化split/folded R-hatとbulk/tail ESSはArviZ 0.20の独立実行へ照合します。
reference.en: Retain analytic integral/GBM solutions, Gaussian moments/CDF and known AR(1) controls. Compare the new mixture with its known moments, CDF and mode occupancy; compare ACF on identical chains with direct sums, and rank-normalized split/folded R-hat plus bulk/tail ESS with independently executed ArviZ 0.20.

refinement.ja: 旧MCの256 seed・GBMの4096経路・単峰MCMCの32鎖を保持。新混合例は3シナリオ×3固定seedで、分布誤差・峰移動・観測量x/峰指示変数の診断を分けます。意図した混合不良が検査に合格しても推定成功とは表示せず、固定閾値を普遍的な保証や偽陽性率と扱いません。
refinement.en: Retain the old 256-seed MC, 4096-path GBM and 32-chain unimodal MCMC checks. For the new mixture use three scenarios × three fixed seeds, separating distribution errors, mode transitions and diagnostics for x/mode indicators. Passing an intentional poor-mixing check is not estimation success; thresholds are neither universal guarantees nor false-positive rates.

next.ja: 既知対称性を持つ1次元2峰標的の限定比較です。任意の多峰性・高次元・実際の推論モデル、一般SDE、普遍的な混合保証や診断の信頼性は未検証です。R-hat≈1や大きなESSだけでは未探索の峰を否定できません。
next.en: A scoped comparison for a 1D bimodal target with known symmetry. Arbitrary multimodal/high-dimensional or real inference models, general SDEs, universal mixing guarantees and diagnostic reliability remain unvalidated. R-hat near one or large ESS cannot rule out unexplored modes.

scope.ja: 12手法のうちLangevinとCSVRの2手法に専用実装。旧1自由度Langevin/BAOABの調和例を保持し、別版の同じOBABO分割で、非縮退2自由度の調和系とquartic係数λ=0.2の2自由度非調和系を比較します。CSVR単独の運動エネルギー核も検査。他の10手法は実装予定です。
scope.en: Two of the 12 methods have dedicated implementations: Langevin and CSVR. Preserve the earlier one-degree-of-freedom harmonic Langevin/BAOAB case. A separate edition compares both baths with the same OBABO splitting for a nondegenerate two-degree harmonic system and a two-degree anharmonic system with quartic coefficient lambda=0.2, and checks the standalone CSVR kinetic-energy kernel. The other 10 methods remain planned.

reference.ja: CSVR核はGamma正準分布・CIRの条件付きモーメントと解析的な運動エネルギーACFに照合。新調和系はOBABOの共通shadow Gaussian、quartic系は独立求積の正準分布・モーメントを参照。旧BAOABの離散Lyapunov照合は別版の根拠として保持。
reference.en: Check the CSVR kernel against canonical Gamma statistics, CIR conditional moments and analytic kinetic-energy ACF. New harmonic runs use the shared OBABO shadow Gaussian; quartic runs use independent quadrature for canonical distributions and moments. Preserve the earlier BAOAB discrete-Lyapunov check as evidence for its separate edition.

refinement.ja: 同じOBABO分割で浴の種類を比較し、刻み・結合・独立系列の標本不確かさを分離。分布・温度揺らぎと時間相関を別々に確認し、LangevinとCSVRの相関の一致は要求しません。相関は方法依存の標本化動力学です。
refinement.en: Compare bath choices under the same OBABO splitting; separate step/coupling effects and independent-stream sampling uncertainty. Check distributions and temperature fluctuations separately from correlations. Langevin and CSVR correlations need not agree: they describe method-dependent sampling dynamics.

next.ja: 非調和系は固定した小さな2自由度例に限定。一般多体系・拘束・重心除去、広い結合時間走査、他10手法、BOMD／CPMDと熱浴の連成は未検証。CSVR核の診断を独立した物理問題へ加算しません。
next.en: Anharmonic evidence covers only the fixed small two-degree example. General many-body systems, constraints/center-of-mass removal, broad coupling sweeps, the other 10 methods and BOMD/CPMD-to-bath coupling remain unvalidated. The CSVR-kernel diagnostic is not an additional independent physical problem.

name.ja: 周期DFT：静的Heと多原子の力
name.en: Periodic DFT: static He and multiatom forces

scope.ja: 固定した1原子単純立方Heセルの周期KS-DFT。PySCFを使う教育用ワークフローで、Γ点／k点、Gaussian軌道基底、FFT補助格子、SCF公差を別々に検査し、同じGTHパラメータ・LDA交換＋VWN5相関のDFTK平面波計算と比較。平衡He結晶や一般物質・金属の検証ではありません。 非対称な2原子He周期セル・局所GTH・LDA交換＋VWN5。PySCFの解析力（Gaussian基底の微分を含む）を全6座標のエネルギー有限差分とDFTK平面波参照で照合し、力の基底・k点・SCF・FFT収束を分離。BOMDの力供給と短い刻み比較に限定し、長時間NVE・CPMD・一般物質は未検証。
scope.en: Periodic KS-DFT for one fixed simple-cubic He cell. An educational PySCF workflow separately checks Gamma/k sampling, Gaussian orbital basis, auxiliary FFT grid and SCF tolerances against independent DFTK plane waves with identical GTH parameters and LDA exchange plus VWN5 correlation. Does not validate equilibrium helium solids, general materials or metals. Asymmetric two-He periodic cell with local GTH and LDA exchange plus VWN5. Compare PySCF analytic forces, including Gaussian-basis derivatives, with energy finite differences for all six coordinates and independent DFTK plane waves. Separate force basis, k-point, SCF and FFT refinement. BOMD coverage is a force interface and short step comparison; long NVE, CPMD and general materials remain unvalidated.

reference.ja: DFTKの別実装・平面波基底と同じ幾何・GTH係数・Libxc汎関数で比較。Gaussianと平面波の有限基底差を含むため、各収束差を併記する。
reference.en: Compare independent DFTK plane waves at identical geometry, GTH coefficients and Libxc functionals. State each convergence difference because finite Gaussian/plane-wave basis differences remain.

refinement.ja: 全エネルギーと力を区別し、k点・Gaussian基底・FFT補助格子・SCF、変位幅、独立平面波カットオフの各系列を保存。
refinement.en: Distinguish total-energy and force convergence. Save k-point, Gaussian-basis, FFT-grid, SCF, displacement-step and independent plane-wave-cutoff sequences.

next.ja: 既存の小規模例・保存済み独立参照と配布物の整合を維持し、必要時に少数の代表再実行を行う。大規模な基底・k点走査、重い独立参照の再生成、長時間BOMD／CPMD、一般物質への拡張は、必要性が指定された場合だけ別途検討する。
next.en: Maintain the existing small examples, saved independent references and release integrity, with a few representative reruns when needed. Large basis/k-point sweeps, expensive reference regeneration, long BOMD/CPMD and general-material extensions are considered separately only on explicit need.

scope.ja: 旧版のSA-AMG、QR／SVD、Krylov固有値、求積の固定例を保持し、条件数・残差・精度と、異方性・右辺摂動と階数閾値・非正規性・狭い山の診断対照を別版で比較します。AMG追加例は代数的診断で、Poissonの格子精度へ加算しません。
scope.en: Preserve the historical SA-AMG, QR/SVD, Krylov and quadrature examples; a separate release compares conditioning, residuals and accuracy with anisotropy, right-hand-side perturbation/rank thresholds, nonnormality and narrow-bump controls. The added AMG case is algebraic and supplies no additional Poisson mesh-accuracy claim.

reference.ja: 旧版の解析Poisson解を保持。追加版は疎直接解・DST、LAPACK、実際の二進入力に対する別環境の高精度演算、解析スペクトル・積分を役割別に照合。NumPy/SciPyはLAPACKを共有し得るため、全層が独立した参照とはしません。
reference.en: Retain the historical analytic Poisson reference. Distinguish sparse direct/DST, LAPACK, separately executed high-precision references for actual binary input, and analytic spectra/integrals. NumPy/SciPy may share LAPACK; independence at every computational layer is not claimed.

refinement.ja: AMGの行列サイズ・異方性・条件数と固定許容残差、QR／SVDの条件数・階数閾値、Krylov次元・固有値間隔・非正規性、求積点数・許容誤差と相殺感度を分離。残差・前進誤差・部分空間誤差・真の積分誤差を別々に測定。
refinement.en: Separate AMG size/anisotropy/conditioning at fixed residual tolerance, QR/SVD conditioning/rank thresholds, Krylov dimension/spacing/nonnormality and quadrature order/tolerances/cancellation sensitivity. Measure residuals, forward errors, subspace errors and true integral errors separately.

next.ja: 小さな固定入力での教育用比較。大規模並列AMG、任意の悪条件・非正規行列、全ての被積分関数、他分野との連成計算の保証には広げません。
next.en: Small fixed-input educational comparisons; no certification of large parallel AMG, arbitrary ill-conditioned/nonnormal matrices, all integrands or coupled applications in other fields.

name.ja: 粒子・静電場・気体運動論

scope.ja: 中性周期電荷のEwald／B-spline SPME、2次元自由空間対数核の真のFMM、1次元cold-plasma PIC、均質Maxwell分子のDSMC衝突成分を小規模検証。 旧5例に加え、同じ問題の独立参照・打切り・格子・時間・保存量・統計診断を別配布版で比較します。 追加固定例は真の2周期スラブ、3D1/r FMM、重力軌道、熱的PICと独立空間演算、物理時間の剛体球壁面流・Mach2衝撃波。
scope.en: Small validations of neutral-periodic Ewald/B-spline SPME, a genuine 2D free-space logarithmic FMM, 1D cold-plasma PIC and a homogeneous Maxwell-molecule DSMC collision component. A separate companion retains the five historical cases and compares independent references, cutoffs, meshes, time steps, conservation and statistical diagnostics for the same targets. Additional fixed cases cover genuine2P slabs,3D1/r FMM,gravity trajectories,warm PIC and independent spatial kernels,and physical-time hard-sphere wall flows/Mach2shocks.

reference.ja: Ewaldの別級数・直接和、SPMEと収束Ewald、FMMの直接粒子和、PICの線形振動、DSMCの保存量・分布診断を区別。 追加版は独立theta積分、2次元対数核のCartesian直接和・解析配置、線形cold-plasma参照、固定運動量・エネルギー球面の解析モーメントと独立標本を役割別に用います。
reference.en: Distinguish alternate Ewald series/direct sums, SPME against converged Ewald, FMM direct particle sums, PIC linear oscillation and DSMC conservation/distribution diagnostics. The companion distinguishes independent theta integrals, Cartesian direct sums/analytic configurations for the 2D log kernel, linear cold-plasma references, and analytic constrained-sphere moments with independent samples.

refinement.ja: 打切り・メッシュ・多重極次数・PIC刻みを各例で確認。SPMEは1993年のLagrange補間PMEそのものではない。DSMCの衝突round数は物理時間と解釈しない。 SPMEの有限格子合力、FMMの木深さと展開次数、PICの粒子数・格子・刻み、DSMCのseed不確かさを別々に記録します。保存診断の合格は軌道や分布の一般保証ではありません。
refinement.en: Check case-specific cutoffs, meshes, multipole order and PIC step refinement. SPME is not the original 1993 Lagrange-interpolation PME. DSMC collision rounds are not interpreted as physical time. Record finite-mesh SPME net force, FMM depth versus expansion order, PIC particle count/mesh/time step and DSMC seed uncertainty separately. Passing conservation diagnostics is no general guarantee of trajectories or distributions.

next.ja: 任意符号・一般境界の3D Coulomb FMM、電磁・多種プラズマ、反応・多原子・実在気体DSMCは別検証です。
next.en: Arbitrary-sign/general-boundary3D Coulomb FMM,electromagnetic/multispecies plasmas,and reactive/polyatomic/real-gas DSMC require separate validation.

scope.ja: 吸収のみの1次元平板で角度離散化と風上空間離散化を実装。散乱や多周波輸送へ広げない。 旧版を保持し、同じ純吸収標的の独立参照・空間/角度収束・放射収支を別配布版で比較します。
scope.en: Implement angular quadrature and upwind spatial discretization in an absorbing 1D slab; excludes scattering and multifrequency transport. Keep the historical release and compare independent references, spatial/angular refinement and radiative balance for the same pure-absorption target in a separate companion.

reference.ja: 厳密ray解、連続角度の指数積分によるfluxを独立参照に使う。 参照自身の求積細分化と、流入・流出・体積吸収の保存診断も区別します。
reference.en: Exact-ray solutions and continuum-angle exponential-integral flux provide independent references. Distinguish refinement of the reference quadrature itself from inflow/outflow/volume-absorption balance diagnostics.

refinement.ja: 厳密rayでの純角度誤差と、同じ角度求積に対する空間誤差を分離。 保存量の整合だけで放射の角度分布の精度を保証しません。
refinement.en: Separate pure angular error using exact rays from spatial error at a fixed angular quadrature. Balance consistency alone does not guarantee angular-distribution accuracy.

next.ja: 散乱、時間依存、多次元・不透明度結合は別の検証が必要。
next.en: Scattering, time dependence, multiple dimensions and opacity coupling require separate validation.
